bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A high-gain lead guitar performs a fast, technical solo featuring rapid alternate picking, legato runs, and wide vibrato. The bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. The drum kit utilizes a double-kick pedal for rapid sixteenth-note patterns, a sharp snare, and frequent crash cymbal accents. 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of E minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar chugging riff, double-kick drums]

[Main Riff]
[syncopated power chords, driving bass guitar]

[Guitar Solo]
[high-gain lead guitar enters, rapid alternate picking, wah-wah pedal effect]
[shredding legato runs, pinch harmonics]

[Outro]
[sustained power chord, final drum fill, cymbal crash]

drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff in E minor. The drum kit features a prominent double-kick pedal pattern and a dry, high-tuned snare. An overdriven bass guitar follows the guitar riff exactly. The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement consists of a rhythmic guitar intro followed by a driving instrumental section with frequent crash cymbal accents.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted eighth notes]
[snare hits on beats 2 and 4]

[Main Section]
[double-kick drum pattern enters]
[overdriven bass guitar enters, doubling guitar riff]
[crash cymbal accents on phrase transitions]

vocals.tags: Indie rock with a lo-fi aesthetic. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated riff using palm-muted eighth notes and occasional open chords. A second electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with a bright, slightly overdriven tone. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar progression with a round, warm tone. Drums feature a tight, dry snare and a steady kick pattern with frequent hi-hat accents. The tempo is 124 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the two guitar tracks.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[clean electric guitar riff with palm muting]
[steady kick drum and hi-hat]

[Section A]
[bass guitar enters]
[second electric guitar enters with melodic lead lines]
[snare drum enters on beats 2 and 4]

[Section B]
[guitar riff continues with less muting]
[hi-hat opens for a more wash-like texture]
